mentions.name: motivational-quotes.net
mentions.description: An AI-powered quotes content site built to scale, where AI generates structured quote pages and an automated pipeline synthesizes quote images from custom JSON templates controlling typography, gradients and layout. Distribution runs through Pinterest for social traffic alongside Google SEO. Currently in an English-language traffic validation phase, with Spanish/Portuguese expansion planned next.
